description: Org-wide Renovate defaults for FactoryGameFan. Repos pull this in with `extends: ["local>FactoryGameFan/.github:renovate-config"]`, which replaces the `config:recommended` and `helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests` lines they used to carry themselves.

WHAT BELONGS HERE: only settings whose reasoning is identical in every repo. Anything derived from one repo's toolchain stays in that repo's own config, next to the comment that explains it. Concretely, these stay out: `minimumReleaseAge` (FactorioMapWebUI's 3 days is computed from pnpm's own 24-hour floor, not an org preference), `vulnerabilityAlerts.minimumReleaseAge` (the 25 hours exists to clear that same pnpm floor by an hour), `lockFileMaintenance` (on in FactorioTools, pinned off in FactorioMapWebUI because it was measured causing TS2321), and every package hold with its reasoning.

MERGE BEHAVIOUR, read from renovate's own `config/utils.js` and options metadata rather than the docs, which do not cover it. `vulnerabilityAlerts` is mergeable, so a repo adding `minimumReleaseAge` to it KEEPS the empty schedule set below - it does not replace the block. `packageRules` is a mergeable array and concatenates with this file's rules FIRST, and later rules win in Renovate, so a repo rule of the same shape overrides the one here. `schedule` and `extends` are NOT mergeable: a repo setting either one replaces this file's value outright.

This repo must be ticked in the Renovate app installation. Renovate cannot read a preset it has no access to, and a repo running with 'Require config file' will then go silently quiet rather than error.

packageRules.description: Group all GitHub Actions bumps into one PR - they share a single CI gate.
